title: Long-lived computer Phase 3: live file view and edit through the owner
description: Fileops items served by the owner through the unprivileged helper, PUT with If-Match, audit, conflicts. Depends on 2a (merged). Contract: docs/LIVE_FILES_PROTOCOL.md. Draft behavior: features/computer_file_live.feature. Sub-tasks: F0 chatticus-7fa35e, A1 chatticus-8bc707, A2 chatticus-6734e9, C chatticus-c658f2, W chatticus-4c646b, E chatticus-4a68c2.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Phase 3 contract written: docs/LIVE_FILES_PROTOCOL.md and the draft features/computer_file_live.feature (PR from branch ts/live-files-contract into develop, not merged). Work split into sub-tasks, in dependency order: F0 chatticus-7fa35e (schemas, constants, file rules), then A1 chatticus-8bc707 (server store, domain, poll, result route) and C chatticus-c658f2 (helper and supervisor) and W chatticus-4c646b (web) in parallel, A2 chatticus-6734e9 (member routes) after A1, E chatticus-4a68c2 (end to end and live proof) last. Eleven product questions for the owner are in section 14 of the contract; none is decided. No infrastructure change is needed.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Contract revision 2 (PR 519, same branch): the owner decided that the computer is needed only to run things. Files are viewed and edited while it is off, through an edit overlay in the snapshot bucket (written only by the Front Door with conditional S3 puts; sealed, applied and cleared by the next owner). An open panel never starts or holds a computer; pace 1 s. New sub-tasks: B chatticus-dfe04 (infrastructure and policy), A3 chatticus-d8849 (overlay core), C2 chatticus-c769b (apply at hydrate). Changed: F0 (overlay schemas), A2 (overlay routing and merge), W (edit while off), E (overlay end to end). Dependencies: A3 after F0; A2 after A1 and A3; C2 after C and F0; E after A2 and C2. Remaining owner questions are Q-O1 to Q-O7 in section 14 of docs/LIVE_FILES_PROTOCOL.md.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Contract revision 3 (PR 519): delete, rename and new folders are required in Phase 3, also while the computer is off. The overlay records put, delete, mkdir and move (a move keeps the content hash and carries no blob); the owner applies them at hydrate in the order mkdir, directory moves, file moves, puts, file deletes, directory deletes; any enabled member may delete files and empty folders and rename, only the owner role deletes a non-empty folder; helper operations mkdir, unlink, rmtree, rename. Non-current bucket versions expire after 30 days (part B). New: A4 chatticus-f9b663 (routes), later-phase ticket chatticus-ed8e4e (customer-account computers editable). Revised: F0, A3, C, C2, W, B, E. Open: two confirmations (Q-P1, Q-P2) in section 14.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Phase 3 complete: PRs 519 to 532 merged; proven live on development 2026-10-13 (offline create, rename, stale 409, hydrate-applied edit, live read/edit/delete/stat, conflict after bot edit, If-Match/ETag through CloudFront). Not proven: Files panel in a browser at 375 px or with a real user. Follow-ups filed: chatticus-bf7fd2, 5dbb7e, f9cfda, 7c6040, d88a0f, 80b17c, e7a52f; existing chatticus-ed8e4e (customer-account computers).
